title: SAS MRM Developer
full_description:
ING Hubs Poland is hiring!
The expected salary for this position: 13 000 - 24 000 PLN gross
The financial ranges specified in the announcement are adjusted and may differ from the range specified in the remuneration regulations.
We are looking for you, if you:
have hands-on experience with theSAS MRM toolor similar custom-built platforms,
are skilled inconfiguring workflows and user interfacesto support model risk governance, using a mix of out-of-the-box and custom configurations tailored to the data model and attributes,
are skilled on SAS scripting, Java xml and HTML,
have worked closely withmodel risk practitionersin a financial institution or consulting environment,
bring stronganalytical and problem-solving skills,
areenthusiastic, communicative, flexible, and a trueteam player,
valuetransparency, open-mindedness, and embracediversity and inclusion,
arebased in Polandor willing to relocate.
You'll get extra points for:
have a knack fortaking initiative, helping others succeed, and staying one step ahead,
enjoychallenging the status quoand proposingcreative, forward-thinking solutions,
have experience with a)SAS Viya, or b) withPython especially for automation or data processing tasks
Your responsibilities:
maintain, update, and enhance theING Model Inventory platform,
design and implement business requirements to support model risk governance, including:workflow configurationUI enhancementsnotifications, dashboards, and reporting
workflow configuration
notifications, dashboards, and reporting
scripting and optimization of data processes,
support ING in evolving itsGlobal Model Risk Management framework,
participate intesting and debuggingactivities to ensure platform stability and performance.
Information about the squad:
TheiModel squadis a fast-growing, dynamic, and international team of highly skilled Risk Experts, Business Analysts, Developers, and IT Engineers. Recognized as one of the most collaborative and happiest teams at ING, we take pride in our strong team spirit and impactful work.
We are responsible for the rollout and maintenance of the infrastructure supporting ING’s Model Risk Management (MRM) framework, which covers all models across ING Bank globally.
To further strengthen our capabilities, we are expanding withinRiskHub Warsaw—a key location supporting both global and local model communities. Our team facilitates model lifecycle execution, oversight, risk monitoring, and regulatory reporting for ING entities worldwide.
The role naming convention in the global ING job architecture will be “Engineer IV”
